title: Adaptive Assurance Gateway: account-sensitive security request scoring and SLA estimator
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit a wide variety of non-bug security & compliance requests (SOC2 artifact asks, ISO questionnaires, HIPAA scoping, GDPR/DPA questions, long vendor questionnaires). Triage today is manual: intake emails/Sheets, ad-hoc prioritization by account manager, and high latency for SLA commitments. This creates poor customer experience, overloaded SEs, and variation in legal/compliance outcomes.

Goal: Build an 'Adaptive Assurance Gateway'—a service and lightweight console flow that ingests incoming security/compliance asks, scores each request by account sensitivity and technical complexity, estimates a recommended SLA lane, and suggests a first-response package (template + evidence links + next-owner). The system should be account-aware (ARR, hosting mode, regulatory flags), routing-aware (hosted/dedicated/private), and produce an auditable decision trail for compliance and handoffs.

Why unique: Instead of a static priority ladder, this gateway applies a hybrid of rule-based heuristics and lightweight ML signals (account profile, prior request latency, question taxonomy) to produce consistent SLA recommendations and reduce manual review steps. It will also surface risky asks that require legal or privacy escalation and provide a small set of pre-approved evidence bundles to accelerate replies.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Define a scoring rubric (account sensitivity, data residency, product-surface impact, legal/regulatory trigger) documented in Confluence.
2) Prototype SLA-estimator that maps score bands to recommended SLAs (48h, 5d, 10d) and owner lanes (SE, Solutions, Legal).
3) Console flow mockups for request intake and recommended reply preview.
4) Pilot pipeline that auto-populates suggested evidence bundles for >=3 common questionnaire templates (SOC2, DPA, GDPR data map).
5) Audit log generated for each decision with timestamp and decision rationale.
6) Dashboard metrics for time-to-first-suggested-response, % automated suggestions accepted, and false-positive escalation rate below 10%.
proposed_solution:
Create a microservice 'assurance-gateway' that:
- Ingests requests via API / email parsing / manual form.
- Applies deterministic rules (region, hosting-mode, contract clauses) + a lightweight classifier trained on historical request labels to output a score.
- Maps score to an SLA lane and response template; suggests evidence bundles stored in a managed repo.
- Emits audit records into the Console's observability pipeline and adds a ticket into Linear if manual review is required.
Hybrid approach rationale: rules ensure legal/regulatory invariants are always enforced; classifier provides rank-ordering for borderline cases and can be tuned with feedback. The first phase will be mostly rules + simple heuristics to minimize legal exposure, then incrementally add ML signals after annotated data reaches ~2k requests.
design_notes: Design should minimize cognitive load: single form with auto-suggested taxonomy tags, one-line SLA estimator badge, and a collapsible rationale panel showing top 3 signals influencing the score. Provide 'fast-accept' and 'request-changes' actions for SEs. Include a compact evidence preview with download links and last-updated timestamp. Explore embedding an LLM-based clarifier to rewrite unclear customer question into a structured ask (opt-in).
engineering_notes:
- Build ingestion adapters for email (Gmail API connector), Drive/Sheets links, and direct Console submission.
- Initial scoring to be implemented as a rules engine (yaml-driven) for easy edits.
- Telemetry: open tracing + event logs to existing Console ingestion.
- Security: redact PII and sensitive artifacts in logs; integrate with KMS for stored evidence.
- Provide feature flag gating for ML-assisted suggestions.
- Estimate: 3 sprint spike + 3 sprint pilot iteration.
rollout_plan:
Alpha (internal): integrate with 2 SEs and 1 Solutions engineer to validate scoring and templates (4 weeks).
Pilot (select customers): test with 3 mid-market accounts across hosted and private modes (6 weeks).
GA: enable self-service for all enterprise accounts with opt-in automation and reporting (target release console-2025.03).
Enablement: ship playbook + CS training + evidence bundle editor in Console.
metrics:
- Median time-to-first-suggested-response (goal < 24h)
- % of requests with automated suggested-template applied (goal >= 40% in pilot)
- SLA adherence delta (pre vs post)
- SE time spent per request (minutes)
- False-positive escalation rate (goal < 10%)
- Customer satisfaction (post-ticket CSAT)
risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: Misclassification sends a high-risk ask to a non-legal owner. Mitigation: conservative default rules keep legal/regulatory triggers escalated; require manual confirmation for high-sensitivity flags.
Risk: Storing customer artifacts raises compliance concerns. Mitigation: encrypt evidence bundles with KMS, retention policies, and RBAC checks; partner with Security & Legal for retention schema.
Risk: Over-automation frustrating customers. Mitigation: include opt-out and human-in-the-loop acceptance before final replies are sent.
Risk: Low-quality ML signals. Mitigation: start with rules; collect feedback labels to improve model iteratively.
